verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official first-party MCP server (trivy-mcp plugin) explicitly advertised for 'Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language,' and a hands-on probe confirms the MCP handshake actually works (JSON-RPC initialize succeeds via `trivy mcp --transport stdio`), enabling AI-native/agentic natural-language operation on top of the standard CLI. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of the natural-language MCP experience beyond the vendor doc and single probe, and no evidence of broader NL command support outside the MCP plugin.
